instructions: This is a static marketing site for landscapedesignsonline.com / PlotVisionAI (Darin's Plot Vision). Prioritize SEO: canonicals to https://www.landscapedesignsonline.com, robots/noindex on vercel.app hosts, sitemap.xml, and GA4 G-GVT2M7WT6J. Flag broken links and accidental indexing of preview hosts.

rules.rule: www.landscapedesignsonline.com must stay indexable. Do not add noindex/nofollow X-Robots-Tag headers or robots meta that would block the production www host. Do not apply vercel.app noindex rules to www. login.html is the only intentional noindex page on www.

.vercel.app hosts must stay noindex. Keep X-Robots-Tag noindex (currently noindex, nofollow) on plotvisionai.vercel.app, plotvisionai-vercel.vercel.app, and other *.vercel.app preview/alias hosts. Do not remove those headers or make preview hosts indexable.
Do not remove Google Analytics 4. Keep the gtag.js snippet and measurement ID G-GVT2M7WT6J on marketing pages.

Do not break visualizer page titles. Keep the PlotVisionAI visualizer <title> (and matching og:title) wording on patio, fence, retaining-wall, and backyard sports pages (Patio Visualizer, Fence Visualizer, Retaining Wall Visualizer, Court Visualizer).
